# Highest paid actor of 2024 made $50 million from one movie as top 10 list revealed
It was apparently the 'highest fee-plus-buyout total in history for a single movie'
[![Olivia Burke](https://resizer.ladbiblegroup.com/unsafe/rs:fit:96:0:0:0/g:sm/q:70/aHR0cHM6Ly9ldS1pbWFnZXMuY29udGVudHN0YWNrLmNvbS92My9hc3NldHMvYmx0Y2Q3NGFjYzFkMGE5OWYzYS9ibHQ5MGE0ZTM3ZWQzMDM2ZWExLzY1MjgxNGNjMzMwN2RmZDQ2MmRkNmU3Mi8zODc0OTU1NjBfMzQ4NTc3MjE0Mjc2MDkxXzU5MjI3NjIyMjQ2OTM1MzIzMDNfbi5qcGc.webp)](https://www.ladbible.com/author/olivia-burke)[Olivia Burke](https://www.ladbible.com/author/olivia-burke)
[![google discover](https://www.ladbible.com/_next/static/media/google-discover.c5ad10d8.svg)Follow us on Google Discover](https://www.google.com/preferences/source?q=ladbible)
The highest paid actors in Hollywood of 2024 have been revealed.
It was a big year at the box office, amid the release of blockbusters such as [_Inside Out 2,_](https://www.ladbible.com/entertainment/film/mindy-kaling-bill-hader-inside-out-2-481786-20240501) [_Deadpool & Wolverine_](https://www.ladbible.com/deadpool-and-wolverine) _,_[_Wicked_](https://www.ladbible.com/entertainment/film/gladiator-ii-wicked-release-date-barbenheimer-barbie-oppenheimer-730894-20240703) and [_Dune: Part Two_](https://www.ladbible.com/entertainment/dune-part-2-release-date-cast-plot-20220701) _._
Advert
But the star who has topped the list of [money](https://www.ladbible.com/money) makers for 2024 didn't appear in any of these popular [flicks](https://www.ladbible.com/tv-and-film), as they didn't need to.
Advert
This clever clogs managed to negotiate _such_ a good deal for one single [movie](https://www.ladbible.com/film) that they could buy a private island and still have **a lot** of pocket change to play with.
So, who's the film star who is absolutely flush with cash after such a successful 2024?
It's [Dwayne 'The Rock' Johnson](https://www.ladbible.com/dwayne-johnson), of course.
As well as being an actor, an absolute tank, one of the most famous [WWE](https://www.ladbible.com/wwe) stars in the [world](https://www.ladbible.com/world-news), and the owner of a [tequila brand](https://www.ladbible.com/entertainment/celebrity/dwayne-johnson-secret-message-tequila-756694-20241113), this bloke is an astute [businessman](https://www.ladbible.com/business).
![The Rock, 52, has been crowned as the highest paid actor of 2024 \(Taylor Hill/FilmMagic\)](https://resizer.ladbiblegroup.com/unsafe/rs:fit:3840:0:0:0/g:sm/q:70/aHR0cHM6Ly9ldS1pbWFnZXMuY29udGVudHN0YWNrLmNvbS92My9hc3NldHMvYmx0Y2Q3NGFjYzFkMGE5OWYzYS9ibHQ4ODU0NmE1YTVlMTIxN2U1LzY3Yzc1ZWM4MThlYjFjMmE4NTE1ZDE3NS9oaWdoZXN0LXBhaWQtYWN0b3ItaG9sbHl3b29kLWR3YXluZS1qb2huc29uLTIwMjQuanBn.webp)
The Rock, 52, has been crowned as the highest paid actor of 2024 (Taylor Hill/FilmMagic)
He beat out a host of [Hollywood](https://www.ladbible.com/us-news)'s largest earners - including the likes of [Ryan Reynolds](https://www.ladbible.com/ryan-reynolds), [Kevin Hart](https://www.ladbible.com/kevin-hart), Jerry Seinfeld and [Hugh Jackman](https://www.ladbible.com/hugh-jackman) - to earn the crown from [Forbes](https://www.forbes.com/sites/mattcraig/2025/02/28/the-highest-paid-actors-of-2024/) this year.
According to the publication, Johnson has got plenty of money stashed away for a rainy day, as the 52-year-old is said to have earned a whopping $88 million in 2024.
And that's _after_ he gave his agent and lawyer a significant slice - so yeah, The Rock is absolutely minted.
Advert
The majority of it comes from his involvement in [Amazon Prime](https://www.ladbible.com/amazon-prime)'s Christmas film [_Red One_](https://www.ladbible.com/entertainment/film/the-rock-highest-paid-actor-amazon-red-one-615963-20230719) _,_ as Forbes say his contract for the movie was worth a hefty $50 million.
It's 'believed to be the highest fee-plus-buyout total in history for a single movie'.
![Johnson's role in Red One has paid off handsomely \(Amazon\)](https://resizer.ladbiblegroup.com/unsafe/rs:fit:3840:0:0:0/g:sm/q:70/aHR0cHM6Ly9ldS1pbWFnZXMuY29udGVudHN0YWNrLmNvbS92My9hc3NldHMvYmx0Y2Q3NGFjYzFkMGE5OWYzYS9ibHRmZjZmOTY4Y2Q3MWIxMTA5LzY3Yzc1ZmU1ODFkZTVkMjZmODYzZmE3ZS9oaWdoZXN0LXBhaWQtYWN0b3ItZHdheW5lLWpvaG5zb24tZWFybmluZ3MtMjAyNC1yZWQtb25lLmpwZWc.webp)
Johnson's role in Red One has paid off handsomely (Amazon)
If you didn't catch it over the festive season, _Red One_ follows the story of Santa Claus (code name: Red One) after he is kidnapped.
It leads to the North Pole's Head of Security (Johnson) teaming up ‘with the world's most infamous bounty hunter’ ([Chris Evans](https://www.ladbible.com/chris-evans)) in a bid to save [Christmas](https://www.ladbible.com/christmas).
Johnson also earned a fair few quid from his return as Maui in _Moana 2,_ while he also worked as a producer on the [Disney](https://www.ladbible.com/disney) film too, which grossed more than $1 billion at the box office.
Fair play, Mr Rock.
Sadly, only one woman managed to make the male-dominated top ten, suggesting that Hollywood still has a long way to go when it comes to paying stars fairly for their work.
Advert
